results.method: npm run typecheck; node --test --test-reporter=tap test/*.test.ts; node src/cli.ts validate; git diff --check; test-link and impact review
results.evidence: All 29 top-level tests passed, with zero failures or skips. The 28 product unit-test catalog entries are matched by exact executed TAP names; the queue example CLI test also passed but has no Stratic product-catalog identity. Three new subprocess tests cover working/historical CLI reads and diagnostics, the selected-file workflow through snapshot/check/prepare/discard/accept, and 25 invalid mutation requests with unchanged file bytes, staging, history, readiness and evidence. Typechecking, structural/link validation and whitespace checks passed. Impact has no missing decisions; shared test helpers are reviewed in the unmapped explanation. Before/after content trees match. Logs: /private/tmp/stratic-cli-suite.txt and /private/tmp/stratic-cli-typecheck.txt. An initial test-only macOS path expectation failure is preserved in /private/tmp/stratic-cli-first.txt; canonical-path comparison corrected it. Desktop integration was not rerun for this test-only addition.

unmapped.reason: Shared imports, the subprocess JSON/exit-status helper, and durable-state hashing support the three linked executable tests. State comparison covers working-file bytes and membership, index bytes, HEAD/history, and local readiness/evidence; Git object creation alone is allowed for snapshots. No application implementation changed.
